.netra-card-meta span:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: '·';
    margin-left: 8px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}
/* R2.4 - clickable link fallback when popup blocked */
.netra-card-link {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.18);
    color: #aef0d0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.4);
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    word-break: break-all;
}
.netra-card-link:hover {
    background: rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.3);
    text-decoration: none;
}
@keyframes card-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.netra-card-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}
.netra-card-label {
    flex: none;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    padding-top: 3px;
    width: 42px;
}
.netra-card-row-bot .netra-card-label { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-card-text {
    color: #ebedf2;
    word-break: break-word;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-size: 13px;
}
.netra-card-row-bot .netra-card-text {
    color: #ffffff;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  DEV PANEL (v13 - glassmorphic console)
 * ============================================================ */
/* R2.12 — VS CODE DARK+ AESTHETIC overrides the glassmorphic look.
   Palette: editor.background=#1e1e1e, sideBar.background=#252526,
   statusBar.background=#007acc, foreground=#cccccc, accent=#0e639c. */
.netra-dev {
    position: fixed;
    top: 18px;
    left: 100px;
    z-index: 100000;
    width: 460px;
    max-width: 96vw;
    max-height: 88vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #cccccc;
    /* R8.2 - compiler-safe base; the glass upgrade (backdrop blur, hue
       border) is layered from the template <style> tag which the SCSS
       compiler never sees. */
    background: #1e1e1e;
    border: 1px solid #3a2a55;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0;                          /* tabs + status bar are flush */
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Consolas', monospace;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 64px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 0 0 1px rgba(139,61,240,0.12), 0 8px 30px -8px rgba(139,61,240,0.25);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
}
/* animated prism hairline across the very top of the console */
.netra-dev::before {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    height: 2px;
    flex: none;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg,
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.8)),
        var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.9)),
        var(--netra-aura2, rgba(160,90,255,0.8)),
        var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.9)),
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.8)));
    background-size: 300% 100%;
    animation: netra-hairline-flow 8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-hairline-flow {
    from { background-position: 0% 0; }
    to   { background-position: 300% 0; }
}
.netra-dev > .netra-dev-body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    padding: 6px 12px 8px;
}
.netra-dev > .netra-dev-body::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; }
.netra-dev > .netra-dev-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #1e1e1e; }
.netra-dev > .netra-dev-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #424242; border-radius: 4px; }
.netra-dev > .netra-dev-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #4e4e4e; }

/* Tab bar (VS Code editor tabs) */
.netra-dev-tabs {
    display: flex;
    background: #252526;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    flex: none;
    user-select: none;
}
.netra-dev-tab {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 8px 6px;
    text-align: center;
    color: #969696;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-right: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}
.netra-dev-tab:last-child { border-right: none; }
.netra-dev-tab:hover { background: #2a2d2e; color: #cccccc; }
.netra-dev-tab.active {
    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;
    /* R8.1 - the active-tab accent follows the live prism hue */
    border-top: 2px solid var(--iris-mid, #8b3df0);
    padding-top: 6px;
}

/* Status bar (R5 - Netra violet gradient, was flat VS Code blue #007acc) */
.netra-dev-statusbar {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5a1aa0 0%, #7a2ecc 45%, #8b3df0 100%);
    color: #ffffff;
    padding: 3px 12px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    flex: none;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(198,96,255,0.45);
    align-items: center;
}
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg + .seg::before {
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    width: 1px;
    height: 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    margin-right: 6px;
}
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg.err   { background: #c72e0f; padding: 0 6px; margin: -3px 0; }
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg.warn  { color: #ffd34d; }
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg-key   {
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    opacity: 0.75;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.netra-dev-statusbar .seg-val   { font-weight: 600; }

/* R2.12.2 - tighten the dev panel header (IDLE / AWAKE / hide pills) */
/* R5 - subtle violet-tinted header to carry the Netra brand */
.netra-dev-head {
    padding: 6px 10px 8px;
    gap: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2140 0%, #241b33 60%, #252526 100%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
}

/* R5 - product identity in the developer console header */
.netra-dev-brand {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}
.netra-dev-glyph {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex: none;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.55)));
}
.netra-dev-glyph-live { animation: netra-glyph-spin 6s linear infinite; transform-origin: 16px 16px; }
@keyframes netra-glyph-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.netra-dev-word {
    font-family: 'Google Sans', 'Inter', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d8c8ff 0%, #c660ff 55%, #7fffb0 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    color: #d8c8ff;
}
.netra-dev-badge-vr {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #ffd7a0;
    background: rgba(255,184,77,0.14);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,184,77,0.4);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 7px;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.netra-dev-pill {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}
.netra-dev-x {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #969696;
}
.netra-dev-x:hover { background: #3a1f66; color: #ffffff; border-color: #8b3df0; }
.netra-dev section { margin: 8px 0; }
/* R2.12 — VS Code "Command Palette" / quickpick button style.
   Solid dark with subtle border. Hover lifts background to #094771
   (VS Code's selected-list-row colour). */
.netra-dev button {
    background: #2d2d2d;
    color: #cccccc;
    border: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease;
}
/* R5 - hover/active lift to Netra violet (was VS Code blue #094771/#007acc) */
.netra-dev button:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #3a1f66;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #8b3df0;
}
.netra-dev button:active:not(:disabled) { background: #4a2a8a; }
.netra-dev button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.netra-dev button.primary {
    background: #6920b8;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #6920b8;
}
.netra-dev button.primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #8b3df0;
    border-color: #8b3df0;
}

/* Pane visibility — driven by c.devTab */
.netra-dev-pane { display: none; }
.netra-dev-pane.active { display: block; }

/* Section headers inside panes (VS Code Outline-view style) */
.netra-dev-pane h4 {
    color: #cccccc;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    margin: 12px 0 6px;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
}
.netra-dev-pane h4:first-child { margin-top: 6px; }

.netra-dev-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    margin-bottom: 0;
    cursor: grab;   /* R1.3 - draggable header */
    user-select: none;
}
.netra-dev-head:active { cursor: grabbing; }
/* R2.5 - NETRA wordmark removed; version pill stretches to fill the gap */
.netra-dev-ver {
    flex: 1;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-left: 2px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #9aa0a6;
}

/* Animated live mic indicator */
.netra-dev-live {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #5f6368;
    flex: none;
    transition: background 0.25s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(129, 201, 149, 0);
}
.netra-dev-live.on {
    background: #81c995;
    animation: netra-live-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-live-pulse {
    0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0   rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.6); }
    50%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0);   }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0   rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.6); }
}

.netra-dev-pill {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: #ebedf2;
    transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}
.netra-dev-pill-idle      { background: rgba(138,180,248,0.18); color: #aecbfa; }
.netra-dev-pill-listening { background: rgba(255,118,118,0.20); color: #ff9b9b; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,118,118,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-awaiting  { background: rgba(174,213,129,0.20); color: #c5e1a5; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(174,213,129,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-thinking  { background: rgba(249,171,0,0.22);   color: #ffd54f; }
.netra-dev-pill-speaking  { background: rgba(129,201,149,0.22); color: #a5d6a7; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(129,201,149,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-paused    { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-pill-dormant   { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #9aa0a6; }
.netra-dev-pill-error     { background: rgba(255,118,118,0.22); color: #ff9b9b; }
.netra-dev-pill-boot      { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-pill-mode      { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #9aa0a6; }
.netra-dev-pill-mode.on   { background: rgba(129,201,149,0.20); color: #a5d6a7; }

.netra-dev-x {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 3px 8px !important;
    opacity: 0.7;
}
.netra-dev-x:hover { opacity: 1; }

.netra-dev-status,
.netra-dev-transcript {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
}
.netra-dev-status div,
.netra-dev-transcript div {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 3px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.netra-dev-status div:last-child,
.netra-dev-transcript div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.netra-dev-status div span:first-child,
.netra-dev-transcript div span:first-child {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    flex: none;
}
.netra-dev-status div b,
.netra-dev-status div em,
.netra-dev-transcript div b,
.netra-dev-transcript div em {
    color: #ebedf2;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-style: normal;
    text-align: right;
    word-break: break-word;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
}
.netra-dev-status div em.on,
.netra-dev-transcript div em.on {
    color: #f9ab00;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(249, 171, 0, 0.4);
}
.netra-dev-status div b.on,
.netra-dev-transcript div b.on {
    color: #a5d6a7;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.4);
}
.netra-dev-status div b.l-err,
.netra-dev-transcript div b.l-err { color: #ff7676; }

.netra-dev-tx-row em {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: left;
    margin-left: 10px;
}

.netra-dev-input {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-dev-input input {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    outline: none;
    transition: border 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.netra-dev-input input::placeholder { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-dev-input input:focus {
    border-color: rgba(138, 180, 248, 0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138, 180, 248, 0.12);
}

.netra-dev-actions {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-dev-actions button { white-space: nowrap; }

/* R1.2 - LIVE MIC LEVEL METER */
.netra-mic-meter {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-status {
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: #c4c7c5;
}
.netra-mic-meter-status.on {
    background: rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.25);
    color: #a5d6a7;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.4);
}
.netra-mic-meter-status.l-err {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
    color: #ff9b9b;
}
.netra-mic-meter-peak {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}
.netra-mic-meter-track {
    height: 10px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 5px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}
.netra-mic-meter-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6dd882 0%, #ffe082 60%, #ff7676 95%);
    border-radius: 5px;
    transition: width 0.08s linear;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.5);
}
.netra-mic-meter-test {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-test button {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3d49 0%, #2c2f3a 100%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-mic-meter-test button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.netra-mic-meter-test em {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* R1 - Real-time graphs */
.netra-dev-graphs {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-graph-card {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
}
.netra-graph-title {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.netra-graph-sub {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}
/* R2.8 - inline numeric labels on graphs */
.netra-graph-title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
.netra-graph-stats {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #ebedf2;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 9px;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
}
.netra-graph-dim { color: #6b7178; font-weight: 400; }
.netra-graph-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 40px;
    display: block;
}
.netra-graph-bars { padding-bottom: 6px; }
.netra-bar-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr 24px;
    gap: 6px;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 2px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
}
.netra-bar-label {
    color: #aecbfa;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.netra-bar-track {
    height: 6px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.netra-bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8ab4f8, #c39bd3);
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.4s ease;
}
.netra-bar-count {
    text-align: right;
    color: #ebedf2;
}
.netra-bar-empty {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-style: italic;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 6px 0;
    font-size: 10.5px;
}

/* R2.2 - voice training */
.netra-dev-train {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-train-title {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-train-sub {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: none;
    margin-left: auto;
}
.netra-train-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-train-row input {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
    min-width: 0;
}
.netra-train-row input::placeholder { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-train-row button {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3d49 0%, #2c2f3a 100%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex: none;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-train-row button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.netra-train-half { flex: 1; }
.netra-train-arrow {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex: none;
}
.netra-train-aliases {
    max-height: 80px;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 4px 0;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 9.5px;
}
.netra-train-alias {
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
}
.netra-train-alias-misheard { color: #ff9b9b; }
.netra-train-alias-arrow    { color: #6b7178; padding: 0 4px; }
.netra-train-alias-intended { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-train-clear {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.12);
    color: #ff9b9b;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-train-clear:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
}

/* R1.4 - last-turn tool trace */
.netra-trace-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr 24px 32px;
    gap: 4px;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    padding: 2px 0;
}
.netra-trace-step {
    background: rgba(127,255,176,0.18);
    color: #a5d6a7;
    border-radius: 3px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 1px 0;
}
.netra-trace-name {
    color: #aecbfa;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.netra-trace-arrow {
    color: #6b7178;
    text-align: right;
}
.netra-trace-ok {
    color: #a5d6a7;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 9px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.netra-dev-voices label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    color: #9aa0a6;
}
.netra-dev-voices label span { flex: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.netra-dev-voices label select {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    outline: none;
}

.netra-dev-log {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    max-height: 260px;
    overflow: auto;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    line-height: 1.55;
}
.netra-dev-log-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 56px 50px 1fr;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
    word-break: break-word;
}
.netra-dev-log-row .t { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-dev-log-row .l {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.netra-dev-log-row .m { color: #e6e6ec; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-err   .l,
.netra-dev-log-row.l-err   .m { color: #ff7676; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-wake  .l { color: #34a853; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-cmd   .l { color: #f9ab00; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-dev   .l { color: #8ab4f8; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-srv   .l { color: #d96570; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-perm  .l { color: #c39bd3; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-init  .l { color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-boot  .l { color: #81c995; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-tts   .l { color: #4dd0e1; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-conv  .l { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-poll  .l { color: #80cbc4; opacity: 0.7; }

.netra-dev-log-empty {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-style: italic;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 12px 0;
}

.netra-dev-badge {
    /* R3.1 - moved from top-left to BOTTOM-LEFT next to the orb. The orb
       lives at bottom-right via .netra-root, but its drag-saved position
       can be anywhere; the DEV badge sticks to the bottom-left corner
       (24px from each edge) so it's predictable and never far from the
       orb's typical resting area. */
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 24px;
    left: 24px;
    z-index: 100000;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36,36,56,0.92), rgba(18,18,28,0.92));
    /* R3.1 - removed `saturate(140%)` from backdrop-filter. Sass parser
       was treating it as the built-in Sass color function `saturate($color,
       $amount)` and complaining about the missing $color argument
       (Performance Analyzer flagged 2 errors). Drop-only fix; the blur
       still gives the glass effect. */
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    color: #d8c8ff;                                   /* R5 - Netra violet, was blue */
    border: 1px solid rgba(139,61,240,0.35);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 14px -4px rgba(139,61,240,0.4);
    transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.netra-dev-badge:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    border-color: rgba(198,96,255,0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 20px -2px rgba(139,61,240,0.55);
}

/* ============================================================
 *  Responsive
 * ============================================================ */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .netra-root { right: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
    .netra-orb  { width: 36px; height: 36px; }   /* R3 - halved */
    .netra-dev  { width: calc(100vw - 24px); }
    .netra-dev-actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

/* ============================================================
 *  R6 "Release X" - HUMAN TURN-TAKING SURFACES
 * ============================================================ */

/* Involuntary blink. The legacy eye-blink-top animation translated a
 * lid whose opacity is 0, so it never rendered; this dedicated layer
 * actually shows. Slow cycle awake, slightly quicker while thinking,
 * suppressed in dormant/error (the main lid or state already covers). */
.netra-eye-blink { pointer-events: none; }
.netra-state-idle .netra-eye-blink,
.netra-state-awaiting .netra-eye-blink,
.netra-state-listening .netra-eye-blink {
    animation: netra-blink 7.3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-thinking .netra-eye-blink {
    animation: netra-blink 4.7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-blink {
    0%, 95.4%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    96.4%, 98.0%    { opacity: 0.92; }
}

/* Barge-in yield flash: one quick violet ripple through the halo the
 * moment Netra stops for the user - "go ahead, I am listening". */
.netra-barged .netra-eye-halo {
    animation: netra-yield-flash 0.7s ease-out 1;
}
.netra-barged .netra-eye-sphere {
    animation: netra-yield-dip 0.7s ease-out 1;
}
@keyframes netra-yield-flash {
    0%   { opacity: 1;    r: 58px; }
    30%  { opacity: 0.35; r: 66px; }
    100% { opacity: 1;    r: 58px; }
}
@keyframes netra-yield-dip {
    0%   { filter: brightness(1); }
    25%  { filter: brightness(1.5) saturate(0.7); }
    100% { filter: brightness(1); }
}

/* R8.1 - FULL CONTROL ticket badge in the dev console header */
.netra-dev-badge-fc {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: #a8ffd0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(46, 184, 88, 0.18), rgba(64, 200, 255, 0.14));
    border: 1px solid rgba(64, 230, 160, 0.55);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px 7px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(64, 230, 160, 0.45);
}

/* Monitor tab: turn-taking telemetry rows */
.netra-dev-status b.fc { color: #7dffb8; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(64, 230, 160, 0.4); }
.netra-dev-status b.on { color: #c660ff; }

/* ============================================================
 *  R7 "Live" - LIQUID AURA + VOICE LAB + CHAT TAB
 * ============================================================ */

/* While she speaks, the sphere goes luminous and the mystic details
 * step back - the liquid aura is the star, GPT-Live style. */
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-pentagram { opacity: 0 !important; }
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-sphere    { filter: brightness(1.18) saturate(1.12); }
.netra-voice-blob-inner { mix-blend-mode: screen; }

/* Chat tab - conversation transcript */
.netra-dev-chat {
    max-height: 240px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-chat-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: baseline;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}
.netra-chat-who {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.chat-you   .netra-chat-who  { color: #7fffb0; }
.chat-netra .netra-chat-who  { color: #c660ff; }
.chat-you   .netra-chat-text { color: #d9e8dd; }
.chat-netra .netra-chat-text { color: #e6dcf5; }
.chat-sys {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
}
.chat-sys .netra-chat-who  { display: none; }
.chat-sys .netra-chat-text { color: #8a7fa8; font-style: italic; font-size: 10px; }
.chat-sys .netra-chat-time { display: none; }
.netra-chat-time { color: #5f5877; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
.netra-chat-empty { color: #6f6790; font-size: 10.5px; font-style: italic; padding: 14px 0; text-align: center; }
.netra-chat-clear {
    align-self: flex-end;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #3a2a55;
    color: #9a8fc0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.netra-chat-clear:hover { border-color: #8b3df0; color: #d8c8ff; }

/* Voice Lab - neural voice picker + pace slider */
.netra-dev-voicelab {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid #2d2440;
}
.netra-voicelab-title {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #b39ddb;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.netra-voicelab-sub { color: #6f6790; font-weight: 400; margin-left: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.netra-voicelab-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 5px 0;
    font-size: 10.5px;
}
.netra-voicelab-row label { color: #8a7fa8; width: 38px; flex: none; font-size: 10px; }
.netra-voicelab-row select {
    flex: 1;
    background: #191024;
    color: #e6dcf5;
    border: 1px solid #3a2a55;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    padding: 3px 6px;
}
.netra-voicelab-row input[type="range"] { flex: 1; accent-color: #8b3df0; }
.netra-voicelab-row em { color: #c660ff; font-style: normal; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; width: 34px; }
.netra-voicelab-row button {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5a1aa0, #8b3df0);
    border: none;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.netra-voicelab-row button:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); }

/* ============================================================
 *  R8 - NETRA LIVE STAGE (dedicated /sp?id=netra_live page)
 *
 *  Full-screen live voice surface: the stage is a
 *  fixed overlay that covers the entire viewport (including the
 *  Service Portal chrome), a warm near-black canvas, one big
 *  organic blob breathing dead-centre, a quiet status line, a
 *  caption of the last thing heard, and two round controls.
 * ============================================================ */

/* On the dedicated page, hide the Service Portal shell entirely so
 * nothing but the stage shows. body gets .netra-live-body from JS. */
.netra-live-body #sp-page,
.netra-live-body .navbar,
.netra-live-body header.sp-navbar,
.netra-live-body .sp-navbar,
.netra-live-body sp-service-portal > header,
.netra-live-body #google_translate_element { display: none !important; }
.netra-live-body { background: #0d0714 !important; overflow: hidden !important; }

.netra-stage {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2147483000;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    /* R8.1 - deep cosmic canvas; the tint rides the live hue */
    background:
        radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 34%, #2a1a45 0%, #1a1030 46%, #0f0a20 100%);
    color: #efe7ff;
    font-family: 'Google Sans', 'Inter', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* soft drifting light so the room feels alive, not flat - now hue-locked */
.netra-stage::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 90vmin; height: 90vmin;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -54%);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.20)) 0%, var(--netra-aura1, rgba(127,255,176,0.06)) 42%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%);
    filter: blur(10px);
    animation: netra-stage-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes netra-stage-breathe {
    0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -54%) scale(1);    opacity: 0.75; }
    50%      { transform: translate(-50%, -54%) scale(1.12); opacity: 1;    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * R8.1 - PRISM ROOM LAYERS
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* faint starfield, two parallax sheets drifting at different speeds */
.netra-stage-stars {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -20%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
        radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 12% 22%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 34% 68%, rgba(255,255,255,0.35) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 56% 12%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 72% 44%, rgba(255,255,255,0.30) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 88% 76%, rgba(255,255,255,0.40) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 22% 86%, rgba(255,255,255,0.28) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1.3px 1.3px at 64% 90%, rgba(255,255,255,0.35) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 44% 38%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1.1px 1.1px at 8% 54%, rgba(255,255,255,0.32) 50%, transparent 51%),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 94% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,0.30) 50%, transparent 51%);
    background-size: 46vmax 46vmax;
    animation: netra-stars-drift 160s linear infinite;
    opacity: 0.5;
}
@keyframes netra-stars-drift {
    from { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
    to   { transform: translate3d(-8vmax, -5vmax, 0); }
}

/* aurora ribbons - two huge blurred conic sweeps in hue-offset colours,
 * counter-rotating very slowly. Amplitude raises their alpha (the vars
 * are written with amp baked in), so the whole room swells when she
 * speaks. transform-only animation = GPU cheap. */
.netra-stage-aurora {
    position: absolute;
    width: 160vmax; height: 160vmax;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    margin: -80vmax 0 0 -80vmax;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(60px) saturate(1.2);
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    will-change: transform;
}
.netra-stage-aurora-1 {
    background: conic-gradient(from 0deg,
        transparent 0deg,
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.14)) 40deg,
        transparent 110deg,
        var(--netra-aura2, rgba(160,90,255,0.11)) 180deg,
        transparent 250deg,
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.10)) 300deg,
        transparent 360deg);
    animation: netra-aurora-spin 90s linear infinite;
}
.netra-stage-aurora-2 {
    background: conic-gradient(from 120deg,
        transparent 0deg,
        var(--netra-aura2, rgba(160,90,255,0.11)) 60deg,
        transparent 140deg,
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.10)) 220deg,
        transparent 300deg);
    animation: netra-aurora-spin 140s linear infinite reverse;
}
@keyframes netra-aurora-spin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* reflective floor sheen under the blob */
.netra-stage-floor {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%; bottom: 6%;
    width: 74vmin; height: 12vmin;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: radial-gradient(50% 100% at 50% 0%, var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.16)) 0%, transparent 75%);
    filter: blur(14px);
    opacity: calc(0.5 + var(--netra-amp, 0) * 0.5);
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* orbit layer: prism rings + ripple host, centred behind the blob */
.netra-stage-orbit {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    width: 0; height: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}
.netra-stage-ring {
    position: absolute;
    width: min(74vmin, 540px); height: min(74vmin, 540px);
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border-radius: 50%;
    /* conic prism band, masked to a thin ring */
    background: conic-gradient(from 0deg,
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.5)),
        var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.6)),
        var(--netra-aura2, rgba(160,90,255,0.5)),
        var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.6)),
        var(--netra-aura1, rgba(64,200,255,0.5)));
    -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 96.5%, #000 97.5%, #000 100%);
    mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 96.5%, #000 97.5%, #000 100%);
    opacity: calc(0.28 + var(--netra-amp, 0) * 0.6);
    animation: netra-ring-spin 26s linear infinite;
    filter: blur(0.4px);
}
.netra-stage-ring-2 {
    width: min(86vmin, 640px); height: min(86vmin, 640px);
    -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 98%, #000 99%, #000 100%);
    mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 98%, #000 99%, #000 100%);
    opacity: calc(0.14 + var(--netra-amp, 0) * 0.4);
    animation: netra-ring-spin 44s linear infinite reverse;
}
@keyframes netra-ring-spin {
    from { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); }
    to   { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); }
}
/* rings tighten and spin faster while she speaks */
.netra-stage-speaking .netra-stage-ring   { animation-duration: 9s; }
.netra-stage-speaking .netra-stage-ring-2 { animation-duration: 16s; }
.netra-stage-thinking .netra-stage-ring   { animation-duration: 5s; opacity: 0.5; }

/* word-onset ripples (spawned from client.js) */
.netra-stage-ripples { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; }
.netra-ripple {
    position: absolute;
    width: min(58vmin, 420px); height: min(58vmin, 420px);
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.6));
    box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.25)),
                inset 0 0 18px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.2));
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.86);
    animation: netra-ripple-out 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.84, 0.44, 1) forwards;
    pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes netra-ripple-out {
    0%   { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.86); opacity: 0.9; }
    100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.65); opacity: 0;   }
}

.netra-stage-head {
    position: absolute;
    top: 22px; left: 0; right: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    z-index: 2;
}
.netra-stage-brand {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #efe7ff, var(--iris-bright, #7fffb0));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.25)));
}
.netra-stage-pill {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    color: #ffd7a0;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,184,77,0.4);
    background: rgba(255,184,77,0.10);
    border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 9px;
}
/* R8.1 - live state pill rides the prism hue */
.netra-stage-pill-state {
    color: var(--iris-bright, #d8c8ff);
    border-color: var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(216,200,255,0.35));
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease;
}

.netra-stage-center {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 30px;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

.netra-stage-blob-wrap {
    appearance: none;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: min(58vmin, 420px);
    height: min(58vmin, 420px);
    padding: 0;
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    /* R8.1 - hue under-glow (the amp-scaled second layer is applied from
       the template <style> tag - compiler-safe there) */
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 60px var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.45)));
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
/* R9.1 - kill the square focus rectangle when the blob is clicked/tapped.
   Keyboard users still get a soft glow ring via :focus-visible below. */
.netra-stage-blob-wrap,
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:hover,
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:active,
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus,
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus-within {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 60px var(--eye-glow, rgba(139,61,240,0.45)))
            drop-shadow(0 0 26px var(--iris-bright, rgba(216,200,255,0.8)));
}
.netra-stage-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }

/* the big blob - warm plasma clay, Netra palette.
 * A state-tinted radial gradient is defined per stage state below; the
 * blob morphs colour as Netra listens (green), thinks (amber) and
 * speaks (violet) - live assistants shift tone, so does she. */
.netra-stage-blob-outer {
    fill: url(#netra-stage-grad);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(127,255,176,0.35)));
    transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.netra-stage-blob-inner {
    fill: url(#netra-blob-inner-gradient);
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    opacity: 0.9;
}
/* R8.1 - the blob's gradient stops are written live by the prism
 * engine (idle emerald, capture cyan, thinking magenta churn,
 * speaking voice-modulated violet) - no static state palettes. */
.netra-stage .nsg-0 { stop-color: var(--nsg-0, #eafff2); }
.netra-stage .nsg-1 { stop-color: var(--nsg-1, #7fffb0); }
.netra-stage .nsg-2 { stop-color: var(--nsg-2, #2eb858); }
.netra-stage .nsg-3 { stop-color: var(--nsg-3, #063d1f); }
/* speaking blob bloom + dormant desaturation live in the template <style>
   tag (calc*var drop-shadow and grayscale(number) break the SCSS fork) */
.nsg-0, .nsg-1, .nsg-2, .nsg-3 { transition: stop-color 0.2s linear; }

.netra-stage-status {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    color: #cdbff0;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 24px;
    animation: netra-status-fade 0.4s ease;
    /* R8.1 - quiet glass chip so the status floats over the aurora */
    padding: 8px 22px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
    border: 1px solid var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(216, 200, 255, 0.14));
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: border-color 0.5s ease;
}
@keyframes netra-status-fade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }

.netra-stage-caption {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: #8f83b5;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 640px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    min-height: 22px;
    font-style: italic;
    animation: netra-status-fade 0.3s ease;
}
/* R8.1 - Netra's own words while she speaks: brighter, hue-kissed */
.netra-stage-caption-netra {
    font-style: normal;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #ded2ff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.3));
}

.netra-stage-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 22px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-bottom: 46px;
    z-index: 2;
}
.netra-ctl {
    width: 62px; height: 62px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(216,200,255,0.25);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: #efe7ff;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.14s ease, background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.netra-ctl:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: var(--eye-glow, rgba(216,200,255,0.5)); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.25)); }
.netra-ctl-muted { background: rgba(255,90,90,0.16); border-color: rgba(255,120,120,0.5); color: #ffb3b3; }
.netra-ctl-end { background: rgba(255,90,90,0.10); border-color: rgba(255,120,120,0.35); }
.netra-ctl-end:hover { background: rgba(255,90,90,0.22); }

/* ============================================================
 *  R8.1 - NETRA LAB (diagnostics console on the Live stage)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-ctl-lab-on {
    background: var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139,61,240,0.25));
    border-color: var(--eye-glow, rgba(216,200,255,0.6));
    color: var(--iris-bright, #d8c8ff);
}
/* R8.2 - the .netra-lab window frame (position:fixed glass slab) and its
   entrance keyframes live in a literal <style> tag inside template.html:
   ServiceNow's SCSS compiler silently ate this block (backdrop-filter +
   saturate + calc/var combos), which is why the Lab rendered unstyled.
   Only compiler-safe inner styles remain here. */
.netra-lab::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
.netra-lab::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(139,61,240,0.35); border-radius: 4px; }
.netra-lab-head {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 14px 0 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,12,26,0.98) 70%, rgba(16,12,26,0));
    z-index: 1;
    cursor: move;   /* drag the window from its title bar */
    user-select: none;
}
.netra-lab-grip { color: #6f6790; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: -2px; cursor: move; }
.netra-lab-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--iris-bright, #d8c8ff), #ffffff);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
.netra-lab-sub { flex: 1; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #8f83b5; }
.netra-lab-x {
    background: none; border: none; color: #b4a9d6;
    font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 2px;
}
.netra-lab-x:hover { color: #ffffff; }
.netra-lab-sec {
    border: 1px solid rgba(216, 200, 255, 0.10);
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028);
    padding: 10px 12px 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.netra-lab-sec-title {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    color: var(--iris-bright, #b9a8ee);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.netra-lab-chip {
    font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    border: 1px solid rgba(216,200,255,0.22);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: #cdbff0;
    border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 7px;
}
.netra-lab-chip.ok  { color: #7dffb8; border-color: rgba(64,230,160,0.5); }
.netra-lab-chip.bad { color: #ff9d8f; border-color: rgba(255,110,90,0.55); }
.netra-lab-scope {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 72px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    border: 1px solid rgba(216, 200, 255, 0.08);
}
.netra-lab-row { margin-top: 8px; }
.netra-lab-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.netra-lab-btns button {
    background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.16);
    border: 1px solid var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.4));
    color: #e4dbff;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.netra-lab-btns button:hover { background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.32); border-color: var(--eye-glow, rgba(198,96,255,0.7)); }
.netra-lab-btns button[disabled] { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.16); }
.netra-lab-btns em { color: #9fe8c0; font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; }
.netra-lab-calib-sentence {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #f0eafc;
    background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.10);
    border-left: 2px solid var(--iris-mid, #8b3df0);
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    padding: 7px 10px;
}
.netra-lab-kv { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; }
.netra-lab-kv span { flex: none; width: 52px; color: #8f83b5; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding-top: 1px; }
.netra-lab-kv em { font-style: normal; color: #d9d0f0; line-height: 1.45; }
.netra-lab-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.netra-lab-grid > div {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 2px 10px 2px 0;
}
.netra-lab-grid span { color: #8f83b5; }
.netra-lab-grid b { color: #eae4f8; font-weight: 600; }
.netra-lab-grid b.bad  { color: #ff9d8f; }
.netra-lab-grid b.warn { color: #ffd34d; }
.netra-lab-hue-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
/* R9 - Lab preference controls */
.netra-lab-slider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.netra-lab-slider label { color: #8f83b5; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; flex: none; }
.netra-lab-slider input { flex: 1; accent-color: #8b3df0; }
.netra-lab-slider em { font-style: normal; color: #eae4f8; width: 34px; text-align: right; }
.netra-lab-selects { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.netra-lab-selects label { color: #8f83b5; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; width: 70px; flex: none; }
.netra-lab-selects select {
    flex: 1;
    background: #14101f;
    color: #e4dbff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.35);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    padding: 4px 6px;
}
.netra-lab-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: #cdbff0; font-size: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.netra-lab-check input { accent-color: #8b3df0; }
.netra-lab-cmd { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.netra-lab-cmd input {
    flex: 1;
    background: #14101f;
    color: #f0eafc;
    border: 1px solid rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.35);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
}
.netra-lab-cmd input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(198, 96, 255, 0.7); }
.netra-lab-cmd button {
    background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.16);
    border: 1px solid rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.4);
    color: #e4dbff;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.netra-lab-cmd button[disabled] { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
.netra-lab-swatch {
    width: 22px; height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, var(--iris-bright, #aef0d0), var(--iris-mid, #2eb858) 60%, var(--iris-deep, #021a0d));
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--eye-glow, rgba(127,255,176,0.55));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .netra-stage-blob-wrap { width: 72vmin; height: 72vmin; }
    .netra-stage-status { font-size: 15px; }
    .netra-stage-controls { padding-bottom: 34px; }
    .netra-lab { top: 56px; right: 10px; width: calc(100vw - 20px); max-height: calc(100vh - 70px); }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Voice-first accessible assistant. Floating mic dock; Web Speech STT/TTS; Gemini tool-calling brain.</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>netra-mic</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>Netra Mic</name><option_schema>[]</option_schema><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Netra Mic widget - SERVER SCRIPT (R9)
 *
 * this is the back half of Netra: one big action router + the Gemini
 * function-calling loop + ~85 tools. the model decides when to call a
 * tool (create ticket, list, resolve, describe the form, whatever) and
 * we run it thru GlideRecord / the Netra script includes, then loop the
 * result back for a natural spoken reply.
 *
 * headline stuff thats in here now:
 *   - FULL ticket control on every ticket type (writes on by default,
 *     ticket_writes=false is the emergency kill-switch)
 *   - form intelligence: mandatory fields, buttons + what they do,
 *     field-change effects, pre-submit checks, flows, approvals,
 *     related records, my_recent_records
 *   - reminders, prosody-aware sentiment, short-form ticket numbers,
 *     the analyst/developer lexicon that seeds the recogniser
 *   - one gotcha to remeber: this whole file is a single IIFE and the
 *     router at the top runs first, so data tables MUST be hoisted
 *     functions, never plain vars (learned that one the hard way)
 *
 * Setup:
 *   System Property  x_196061_netra_v1.gemini_api_key   = <your key>
 *   System Property  x_196061_netra_v1.gemini_model     = gemini-2.5-flash  (optional)
 *
 *   Get a free Gemini API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
 *
 * Protocol:
 *   input.action == 'chat'      -> input.message, input.history -> data.response
 *   input.action == 'poll'      -> data.notifications
 *   input.action == 'reset'     -> clears server-side memory (history is client-side)
 *   (initial load)              -> data.user_name, data.paused, data.has_api_key
 */
(function () {

    var SCOPE = 'x_196061_netra_v1';
    var user  = gs.getUserID();

    var action = (input && input.action) ? String(input.action) : null;

    // ---- Always-on state (cheap: needed by every action incl. the 9s poll) ----
    data.user_name   = gs.getUserDisplayName();
    data.user_sys_id = user;
    data.error       = null;
    data.has_api_key = !!gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key');

    // R4.7 - PERF: one query both ensures a pref row exists AND reads pause
    // state, replacing the previous two back-to-back GlideRecord queries on
    // the same _user_pref row. Runs on every action because poll needs pause.
    _ensurePrefAndPause();

    // R4.7 - PERF: vocab (5 GlideRecord queries, ~80ms) and the training blob
    // are consumed by the client ONLY at boot, to build the speech recognizer.
    // They were previously rebuilt on EVERY server call - including the
    // 9-second notification poll - so an idle widget ran ~6 needless queries
    // and shipped a fat vocab/training payload back every 9s, forever. Build
    // them only on the initial widget load (action === null). The client keeps
    // its boot snapshot, so poll/chat turns no longer need them re-sent.
    // R2.3 - per-user voice training (vocab + aliases) lives in the Netra
    // Context row; expose it so the client can rebuild personal recognizer
    // hints from server truth.
    if (!action) {
        data.vocab = _getVocab();
        try {
            var trainSnap = _trainingRead();
            data.training = {
                vocab:   trainSnap.vocab   || {},
                aliases: trainSnap.aliases || {}
            };
        } catch (eT) { data.training = { vocab: {}, aliases: {} }; }
    }

    if (action === 'chat') {
        try {
            // R4.5 - cap the user message. The history-byte cap below only
            // trims old turns; the CURRENT message is fed raw to Gemini. A
            // hostile multi-MB payload could blow the 12s HTTP timeout
            // before any history trim runs. Release X: 8000 -> 16000 so a
            // long spoken dictation never gets cut mid-thought.
            var _userMsg = String((input && input.message) || '').trim();
            if (_userMsg.length > 16000) _userMsg = _userMsg.substring(0, 16000);
            // image_b64 cap - 4 MB base64 ~ 3 MB binary, plenty for a screen
            if (input && typeof input.image_b64 === 'string' && input.image_b64.length > 4000000) {
                input.image_b64 = input.image_b64.substring(0, 4000000);
            }
            data.response = _chat(
                _userMsg,
                (input && Array.isArray(input.history)) ? input.history : [],
                !!(input && input.live_mode),
                (input && input.prosody) || null
            );
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[NetraGemini] chat outer error: ' + e);
            data.response = { ok: false, message: 'Sorry, I hit a server error: ' + String(e.message || e) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'poll') {
        try {
            if (data.paused) {
                data.notifications = [];
            } else {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(SCOPE + '_notification');
                gr.addQuery('user', user);
                gr.addQuery('delivered', false);
                gr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
                gr.setLimit(10);
                gr.query();
                var out = [];
                while (gr.next()) {
                    out.push({
                        id: String(gr.sys_id),
                        message: String(gr.message),
                        kind: String(gr.kind),
                        ticket_number: String(gr.ticket_number)
                    });
                    gr.delivered = true;
                    gr.delivered_at = new GlideDateTime();
                    gr.update();
                }
                data.notifications = out;
            }
        } catch (eP) {
            gs.error('[NetraGemini] poll: ' + eP);
            data.notifications = [];
        }
    } else if (action === 'save_training') {
        // R2.3 - client sends its current vocab + aliases blob; we persist it
        try {
            var v = (input && input.vocab)   ? input.vocab   : null;
            var a = (input && input.aliases) ? input.aliases : null;
            if (!v && !a) {
                data.training_result = { ok: false, error: 'Neither vocab nor aliases provided.' };
            } else {
                _trainingWrite(v, a);
                var saved = _trainingRead();
                data.training_result = {
                    ok: true,
                    vocab_count:   Object.keys(saved.vocab).length,
                    aliases_count: Object.keys(saved.aliases).length,
                    message: 'Training saved to ServiceNow.'
                };
            }
        } catch (eTS) {
            data.training_result = { ok: false, error: String(eTS.message || eTS) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'clear_training') {
        try {
            _trainingWrite({}, {});
            data.training_result = { ok: true, message: 'Training cleared.' };
        } catch (eC) {
            data.training_result = { ok: false, error: String(eC.message || eC) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'gemini_tts') {
        // R2.8 - synthesise the given text via Gemini's native TTS model
        // (gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts). Same Gemini API key, no extra
        // service. Returns base64 PCM 24kHz mono which the client wraps
        // in a WAV header and plays. Falls back gracefully if the model
        // is unavailable - client retries via Edge TTS.
        try {
            var text  = String((input && input.text)  || '').substring(0, 4000);
            var voice = String((input && input.voice) || 'Kore');
            if (!text) {
                data.gemini_tts = { ok: false, error: 'no text' };
            } else {
                var key = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key');
                if (!key) {
                    data.gemini_tts = { ok: false, error: 'no api key' };
                } else {
                    var url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts:generateContent?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key);
                    var body = {
                        contents: [{ parts: [{ text: text }] }],
                        generationConfig: {
                            responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
                            speechConfig: {
                                voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName: voice } }
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
                    rm.setEndpoint(url);
                    rm.setHttpMethod('POST');
                    rm.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
                    rm.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(body));
                    rm.setHttpTimeout(15000);
                    var r = rm.execute();
                    var code = r.getStatusCode();
                    if (code !== 200) {
                        data.gemini_tts = { ok: false, error: 'HTTP ' + code, body: String(r.getBody() || '').substring(0, 200) };
                    } else {
                        var parsed = JSON.parse(r.getBody() || '{}');
                        var part = parsed && parsed.candidates && parsed.candidates[0] &&
                                   parsed.candidates[0].content && parsed.candidates[0].content.parts &&
                                   parsed.candidates[0].content.parts[0];
                        if (part && part.inlineData && part.inlineData.data) {
                            data.gemini_tts = {
                                ok: true,
                                mime: String(part.inlineData.mimeType || 'audio/L16;rate=24000'),
                                b64:  String(part.inlineData.data),
                                voice: voice
                            };
                        } else {
                            data.gemini_tts = { ok: false, error: 'no audio in response' };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (eG) {
            data.gemini_tts = { ok: false, error: String(eG.message || eG) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'rewind_mem') {
        // R2.10 - conversational repair: pop the last conversation exchange from
        // the unified Context blob. Client also drops the last 2 entries from
        // geminiHistory so the next chat call starts clean.
        try {
            var blob = _ctxReadBlob();
            var rewinded = false;
            if (blob.mem && blob.mem.length) {
                blob.mem.pop();
                _ctxWriteBlob(blob);
                rewinded = true;
            }
            data.rewind_result = { ok: true, popped: rewinded, mem_length: (blob.mem || []).length };
        } catch (eR) {
            data.rewind_result = { ok: false, error: String(eR.message || eR) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'debug') {
        try {
            var key = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key') || '';
            var mdl = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_model', 'gemini-flash-lite-latest');
            var toolDecls = _toolDeclarations();
            var toolNames = [];
            if (toolDecls[0] && toolDecls[0].functionDeclarations) {
                for (var ti = 0; ti < toolDecls[0].functionDeclarations.length; ti++) {
                    toolNames.push(toolDecls[0].functionDeclarations[ti].name);
                }
            }
            data.debug = {
                version: 'v7.0',
                scope: SCOPE,
                user_name: gs.getUserDisplayName(),
                user_sys_id: user,
                model: mdl,
                api_key_status: key ? ('set (length=' + key.length + ', prefix=' + key.substring(0, 6) + ')') : 'MISSING',
                tool_count: toolNames.length,
                tools: toolNames,
                paused: !!data.paused,
                paused_until: data.paused_until || '',
                server_time: String(new GlideDateTime())
            };
        } catch (eD) {
            data.debug = { error: String(eD.message || eD) };
        }
    }

    /* ===================================================================
     *  Gemini chat with tool use
     * =================================================================== */
    function _chat(userMessage, history, liveMode, prosody) {
        if (!userMessage) {
            return { ok: false, message: 'I did not catch that. Kindly say it again.' };
        }
        // R8.2 - voice-delivery metadata rides the turn as a bracketed tag
        // the model reads but never speaks (prompt explains the format).
        if (prosody && (prosody.wpm || prosody.level)) {
            userMessage += ' [voice delivery: ' +
                (prosody.wpm ? ('~' + prosody.wpm + ' wpm') : '') +
                (prosody.level ? (', loudness ' + prosody.level + '/100') : '') +
                (prosody.variance ? (', dynamics ' + prosody.variance) : '') + ']';
        }
        var apiKey = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key');
        if (!apiKey) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                message: 'My AI key has not been configured yet. Kindly set the system property ' +
                         SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key with your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.'
            };
        }
        // R4.7 - PERF: default to gemini-flash-lite-latest (~1.0s) instead of
        // gemini-2.5-flash (~2-4s with thinking-token overhead). The tool-use
        // loop can fire this model up to 5 times per turn, so the primary model
        // choice dominates perceived latency. flash-lite handles Netra's tool
        // calls well and was already the first fallback the chain relied on;
        // making it the *primary* removes 1-3s from every voice turn. Override
        // via the x_196061_netra_v1.gemini_model property if richer reasoning
        // is needed on a given instance.
        var model = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_model', 'gemini-flash-lite-latest');
        // R7 - AUTO-ROUTED BRAINS. Simple commands stay on flash-lite
        // (~1s); turns that smell like reasoning (long, multi-question,
        // analytical verbs, multi-step) escalate to gemini-2.5-flash for
        // a smarter answer at +1-2s. Only applies when the property is
        // still the default - an explicit gemini_model pins every turn.
        var routeReason = 'fast';
        if (model === 'gemini-flash-lite-latest') {
            if (_isComplexTurn(userMessage)) { model = 'gemini-2.5-flash'; routeReason = 'complex'; }
        } else {
            routeReason = 'pinned';
        }

        // Build conversation history for Gemini.
        // R2.7 sanitisation, Release X expansion: flash-lite carries a 1M-token
        // context window, so the old 12-turn / 60KB guard rails were wasting
        // most of the model's memory. New envelope:
        //   - Keep last 40 turns
        //   - Truncate tool-response bodies over 4000 chars to a digest
        //   - Strip any inlineData (screenshot frames) from past turns
        //   - Hard byte cap: if still over 180KB, drop oldest turns
        var contents = [];
        if (Array.isArray(history)) {
            var start = Math.max(0, history.length - 40);
            for (var i = start; i < history.length; i++) {
                var h = history[i];
                if (!h || !h.role || !h.parts) continue;
                var sanitisedParts = [];
                for (var p = 0; p < h.parts.length; p++) {
                    var part = h.parts[p];
                    if (!part) continue;
                    // Drop inlineData (binary frames) from past turns
                    if (part.inlineData) continue;
                    if (part.functionResponse && part.functionResponse.response) {
                        // Truncate large tool-result bodies in-place
                        var resp = part.functionResponse.response;
                        var s = '';
                        try { s = JSON.stringify(resp); } catch (eS) {}
                        if (s.length > 4000) {
                            sanitisedParts.push({
                                functionResponse: {
                                    name: part.functionResponse.name,
                                    response: { result: { ok: true, _truncated: true, summary: s.substring(0, 2000) + '...[' + (s.length - 2000) + ' more chars trimmed]' } }
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            sanitisedParts.push(part);
                        }
                    } else if (part.text && part.text.length > 6000) {
                        sanitisedParts.push({ text: part.text.substring(0, 6000) + '...[truncated]' });
                    } else {
                        sanitisedParts.push(part);
                    }
                }
                if (sanitisedParts.length) {
                    contents.push({ role: h.role, parts: sanitisedParts });
                }
            }
            // Hard byte cap. R4.7 - PERF: compute the total size once and
            // subtract each dropped turn's own length, instead of
            // re-serialising the entire contents array on every iteration
            // (previously O(n^2) on long sessions).
            var size = JSON.stringify(contents).length;
            while (contents.length > 2 && size > 180000) {
                var dropped = contents.shift();
                size -= JSON.stringify(dropped).length + 1;   // +1 ~ comma separator
            }
            if (size > 180000) {
                gs.warn('[NetraGemini] history still ' + size + ' bytes after pruning; will rely on Gemini to handle');
            }
        }
        // R1.4 - vision support: if the client attached an image, send it
        // as inlineData alongside the text. Gemini 2.5-flash is multimodal.
        var userParts = [{ text: userMessage }];
        if (input && input.image_b64) {
            userParts.unshift({
                inlineData: {
                    mimeType: input.image_mime || 'image/png',
                    data:     String(input.image_b64)
                }
            });
        }
        contents.push({ role: 'user', parts: userParts });

        var systemInstruction = _systemPrompt(liveMode);
        var tools = _toolDeclarations(liveMode);

        // Tool-use loop (max 8 iterations to prevent runaway; Release X
        // raised from 5 so multi-step research turns don't bail early)
        var modelUsed = null;
        var toolsCalled = [];   // R1 - track which tools were invoked
        var clientDirectives = {};   // R2 - navigate_url, click_button_label, etc.
        for (var iter = 0; iter < 8; iter++) {
            var resp = _callGemini(apiKey, model, contents, tools, systemInstruction);
            if (resp._model_used) modelUsed = resp._model_used;
            if (resp.error) {
                gs.error('[NetraGemini] API error: ' + resp.error);
                var friendly = 'Sorry, the AI service is busy right now. Kindly try again in a moment.';
                var err = String(resp.error);
                if (err.indexOf('429') >= 0)        friendly = 'I have hit the rate limit. Kindly wait a minute and try again.';
                else if (err.indexOf('401') >= 0 || err.indexOf('403') >= 0) friendly = 'My API key is not authorised. Kindly check the configuration.';
                else if (err.indexOf('400') >= 0) {
                    // R2.7 - 400 after a long session usually means payload too large.
                    // Tell the client to reset history rather than the misleading
                    // "could not understand" message.
                    friendly = 'My memory has grown a bit too large. Could you say it again? I have just trimmed it.';
                    return { ok: false, message: friendly, error_detail: err, force_history_reset: true };
                }
                else if (err.indexOf('404') >= 0)   friendly = 'The AI model is not available right now.';
                else if (err.indexOf('exhausted') >= 0) friendly = 'All AI models are busy at the moment. Kindly try again in a few seconds.';
                return { ok: false, message: friendly, error_detail: err };
            }

            var candidate = (resp.candidates && resp.candidates[0]) || null;
            if (!candidate || !candidate.content || !candidate.content.parts) {
                return { ok: false, message: 'I got an empty response. Kindly try again.' };
            }

            var parts = candidate.content.parts;
            var functionCalls = [];
            var textChunks = [];
            for (var p = 0; p < parts.length; p++) {
                if (parts[p].functionCall) functionCalls.push(parts[p].functionCall);
                if (parts[p].text) textChunks.push(parts[p].text);
            }

            // If the model called a tool, execute it and loop
            if (functionCalls.length) {
                // Add the model's turn (with the function call) to contents
                contents.push({ role: 'model', parts: parts });

                // Execute each function call and append responses
                var responseParts = [];
                for (var f = 0; f < functionCalls.length; f++) {
                    var fc = functionCalls[f];
                    var result = _runTool(fc.name, fc.args || {});
                    toolsCalled.push(fc.name);   // R1 - record tool call
                    // R2 - hoist client-side directives so the AngularJS
                    // controller can act on them after the reply.
                    if (result && result.navigate_url)       clientDirectives.navigate_url       = result.navigate_url;
                    if (result && result.click_button_label) clientDirectives.click_button_label = result.click_button_label;
                    // R2.4 - open new tab directive
                    if (result && result.open_url)           clientDirectives.open_url           = result.open_url;
                    // R8.2 - local reminder scheduling directive
                    if (result && result.reminder_at_ms) {
                        clientDirectives.reminder_at_ms = result.reminder_at_ms;
                        clientDirectives.reminder_text  = result.reminder_text || 'Reminder.';
                    }
                    gs.info('[NetraGemini] tool ' + fc.name + ' -> ' + JSON.stringify(result).substring(0, 200));
                    responseParts.push({
                        functionResponse: {
                            name: fc.name,
                            response: { result: result }
                        }
                    });
                }
                contents.push({ role: 'user', parts: responseParts });
                continue;
            }

            // Final natural-language reply
            var finalText = textChunks.join(' ').trim() || 'Done.';

            // Persist last spoken utterance into the context table (best-effort)
            try {
                var ctx = new NetraContext();
                ctx.setLastUtterance(finalText);
            } catch (eC) {}

            // Re-read pause state in case a tool toggled it
            _setPauseState();

            // Append the final model turn to contents so client history is complete
            contents.push({ role: 'model', parts: [{ text: finalText }] });

            // R1.4 - persist exchange into long-term memory (capped at 40 turns)
            try { _memAppend(userMessage, finalText); } catch (eM) {}

            // R2.12 - SENTIMENT TRACKING (algorithmic, not prompt-only)
            //   Run a fast Gemini-reason classification on the user's turn,
            //   store result in Context blob, return a flag the client can
            //   surface as a proactive escalation suggestion if two
            //   consecutive frustrated turns are detected.
            var sentimentSignal = null;
            try { sentimentSignal = _trackSentiment(userMessage); } catch (eSent) {
                gs.warn('[NetraSentiment] track failed: ' + (eSent.message || eSent));
            }

            return {
                ok: true,
                message: finalText,
                history: contents,
                paused: data.paused,
                model_used: modelUsed,
                route_reason: routeReason,    // R7 - fast | complex | pinned
                tools_called: toolsCalled,    // R1 - for dev panel graph
                directives: clientDirectives, // R2 - navigate_url / click_button_label
                sentiment: sentimentSignal    // R2.12 - {label, score, consecutive_frustrated, suggest_escalation}
            };
        }

        return { ok: false, message: 'I am thinking too much, kindly try again with a simpler request.' };
    }

    /* ===================================================================
     *  R2.12 - ALGORITHMIC SENTIMENT TRACKING
     *
     *  Per-turn classification (positive / neutral / frustrated) stored in
     *  the Context blob. When the rolling counter of consecutive frustrated
     *  turns hits 2, the response flags suggest_escalation=true so the
     *  client can render a "Want me to escalate?" affordance without
     *  waiting for the LLM's prompt-perception to catch it.
     * =================================================================== */
    // Fast keyword cues that warrant a real LLM classification call. We only
    // burn a Gemini call when one of these is present — otherwise the turn
    // is treated as 'neutral' with no API cost. Keeps free-tier quota usable.
    var SENTIMENT_CUES = [
        'damn', 'stupid', 'still not', 'still broken', "why isn't", "why isnt",
        'why is it not', 'why is this not', 'this is the third', 'this is the fourth',
        'i already', 'i told you', 'i said', 'are you kidding', 'come on',
        'frustrating', 'annoying', 'useless', 'ridiculous', 'urgent', '!!!',
        'urgently', 'asap', 'right now', "doesn't work", 'does not work',
        'not working', 'wrong', "won't work", 'wont work'
    ];

    function _trackSentiment(userMessage) {
        if (!userMessage || userMessage.length < 3) return null;

        // R2.12.1 - two-stage sentiment classification:
        // (1) Fast keyword + ALL-CAPS pre-filter (free, no API call)
        // (2) Gemini classifier ONLY when stage 1 flags potential frustration
        var lc = String(userMessage).toLowerCase();
        var raw = String(userMessage);
        var hasCue = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < SENTIMENT_CUES.length && !hasCue; i++) {
            if (lc.indexOf(SENTIMENT_CUES[i]) >= 0) hasCue = true;
        }
        // SHOUTING ALL CAPS for >5 chars (excluding ticket numbers, etc.)
        if (!hasCue && raw.length > 5) {
            var letters = raw.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '');
            if (letters.length > 5 && letters.toUpperCase() === letters && letters.toLowerCase() !== letters) {
                hasCue = true;
            }
        }

        // Stage 1 verdict: NEUTRAL — bypass Gemini, just bookkeeping
        if (!hasCue) {
            try {
                var b = _ctxReadBlob();
                b.sentiment = b.sentiment || { history: [], consecutive_frustrated: 0 };
                b.sentiment.history.push({ t: new GlideDateTime().toString(), label: 'neutral', score: 0 });
                if (b.sentiment.history.length > 10) b.sentiment.history = b.sentiment.history.slice(-10);
                b.sentiment.consecutive_frustrated = 0;
                _ctxWriteBlob(b);
                return { label: 'neutral', score: 0, consecutive_frustrated: 0,
                         suggest_escalation: false, source: 'keyword_filter' };
            } catch (eN) { return { label: 'neutral', score: 0, error: 'persist_failed' }; }
        }

        // R4.7 - PERF: by default do NOT fire a second, blocking Gemini call on
        // the reply path. A cue word or ALL-CAPS shout is already a strong
        // frustration signal, so classify from it directly and skip the extra
        // ~1-2s LLM round-trip the user would otherwise wait through *before
        // hearing any reply*. The consecutive-frustrated escalation counter
        // still works. Set x_196061_netra_v1.sentiment_llm=true to restore the
        // LLM-refined classification when accuracy matters more than latency.
        var useLlmSentiment = gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.sentiment_llm', 'false') === 'true';
        if (!useLlmSentiment) {
            try {
                var bk = _ctxReadBlob();
                bk.sentiment = bk.sentiment || { history: [], consecutive_frustrated: 0 };
                bk.sentiment.history.push({ t: new GlideDateTime().toString(), label: 'frustrated', score: 0.6 });
